At least 7 people were booked at an Allen County facility on July 11
By
S. G. GrayAt least seven people were booked at an Allen County, Ohio, facility on July 11, 2026.
The "Other" category appeared in seven listed-charge entries across the bookings, while the "Property" category appeared in one. The most common listed charge was "Misdemeanor," which appeared in five charge entries.
Booking records reflect charges as listed at the time of booking. Individuals listed have not been convicted of any charge based on this record.
